description.en: Kirana is a CRM dashboard for agencies, consultants, startups, and finance teams: track clients and deals through a funnel, plan tasks on a calendar, manage invoices and growth, and keep projects and contacts in one place.
description.id: Kirana adalah dashboard CRM untuk agensi, konsultan, startup, dan tim keuangan: pantau klien dan deal lewat funnel, rencanakan tugas di kalender, kelola invoice dan pertumbuhan, serta simpan proyek dan kontak di satu tempat.
